text:
Nina: Hey folks, corpcard charge for my taxi in Barcelona shows a +4.00 EUR FX fee on the vendor receipt. Corpcard transaction matched but the vendor also added a separate "merchant conversion" line. I paid no extra personally but curious if Finance covers merchant conversion fees or do we only reimburse base fares?

Tom (Finance): Good question. Policy is we cover the expense total charged to the corpcard. If the merchant posts a separate conversion fee on the same charge and it hit the corporate account, we cover it. If you paid that fee personally, we normally reimburse if it's a direct result of corpcard decline or forced conversion.

Nina: I didn't pay it personally, it hit the corpcard. But vendor included both a fare and a "dynamic currency conversion" line on their PDF. Is there any chance Finance can ask the vendor to refund the DCC?

Jorge (Ops): Vendor DCC is messy. Travel ops can request invoice adjustment but typically vendor won't retro-reverse DCC. If it hit the corpcard, agree with Tom that Finance will absorb. If we have repeated DCC from same vendor we should blacklist their conversion option.

Nina: Cool, thanks. Filing an expense to reconcile because the accounting export shows two separate GL lines and it confused the approver.

Nina: Submitted EXP-4120; attached receipt: https://files.redwood.example/receipts/2002109876-taxi.pdf. Note in form: "Vendor DCC line included; charge on corpcard; please confirm GL mapping"

ExpenseBot: EXP-4120 received. Status: queued for review. Estimated processing 3 business days.

Tom (Finance): Reviewing. For bookkeeping we'll map fare -> Travel Transport, DCC -> Bank Fees. Both covered if charged to corpcard. No action needed from Nina.

Ava (People Ops): Quick payroll note: if reimbursement is due to Nina (e.g., she paid personally), payroll runs on 15th. But since corpcard covered it no payroll action needed.

Nina: Got it, thanks. One related thing  the driver added a tip in cash that I reimbursed personally. How should I submit that?

Tom (Finance): Submit a separate expense line: category "Travel - Tips" payment method = Personal Card. Attach a photo of the cash receipt or a short note with driver name/time. Tips <= 20 EUR are auto-approved if manager confirms.

Nina: Ok added EXP-4121 for tip (12 EUR) with photo. Tagging Jorge for manager approval.

Jorge (Ops): Approved. :thumbsup:

Tom (Finance): Both items approved. EXP-4120 closed (no employee reimbursement). EXP-4121 approved for reimbursement to bank transfer next payroll cycle unless you select immediate transfer.

Nina: Selecting bank transfer. Thanks everyone!

Jorge (Ops): We'll also flag that vendor in the travel vendor list for ops review.

ExpenseBot: EXP-4121 queued for payment. ETA 5 business days.

Nina: Closing thread.
